book.name: Marcos
book.title: Evangelio según Marcos Jesucristo roy pjl̈ú ëre, e jyã tara Marcosdë

content: Jesucristo, e Sbö Wa. E roy pjl̈ú l̈i soyozl̈ong eni.
Juan No Waga shäng kjok dogro no l̇l̇ëmshko
Kjibokwo tara Sbö tjl̈õkwo l̈aga tek dënashko so Isaíasdë. Tjl̈ẽno beno eni:

content.text: irbo poshäryë bop kong wl̈o” l̈e.
Kjok dogro no l̇l̇ëmshko ga ëbo tjl̈ẽ shäng dbo go ga

content: Eni ga no weno shäng kjl̈ara ko Juan. E doyono shäng shwong sek öng jëkkl̈o sok kësbang zok go, dop pjrikkl̈o shäryak öng kwota go bakoe. Dl̈i ba kong ue wl̈o l̈i, e sekwa, or kjl̈oshko so dyo bakoe. E öötong shäng kjok dogro no l̇l̇ëmshko ga shäng oba wë jer di roshko ga tjl̈ẽ oba kong ga «L̇l̇ëbo owa shäryëmi l̈öng l̈i, e owa jl̈õe l̈ozĩ, ga rayozĩ, ga pjãy wër jer di roshko. Shäryoromi eni ga owa pjang bomi go l̈i l̈ö̃ya Sbörë ber drete» l̈e. Judea sopga, Jerusalén sopga, e shrono l̈öng träk l̇l̇ëm ba kuk. Eshko ga kjone kjone, l̇l̇ëbo owa shäryara l̈i l̈e oba uunkong bokshto. E irgo ga we Juandë jer Jordán diyo roshko.
Ga Juan tjl̈ẽ oba kong ga «No tjwe bor irgo kjl̈ara. Bek wl̈o ga tja ba drepkwota dök wl̈o l̇l̇ëm, e tjwl̈õ ara bor kjinmo anmoyõ kjĩshko.
Pjãy wër shäng di goshko, gueniyo domer tjwe bor irgo l̈ira, pjãy go Sbö Sëya iche tjwe ber kësbang bomi tjok» l̈e.
Jesús wara Juandë
Eshkoshko ga Jesús opshino jek Nazaret kjokyo dwayo, e Galilea kjokyo obi, ga öötong shäng Jordán diyo, Juan shängshko. Eshko ga wara Juandë jer Jordán diyo roshko.
Wara pjir ga Jesús opshik tëm shäng di roy dwayoshko ga ĩya ga kjok dogo roshwino beno oojong erä, ga Sbö Sëya to ter kjok dogo dwayo so dunggwo kjoyo, ga opyono sök ba go.
Eshko ga ybö kuraba kjok dogo dwayo, tjl̈ẽ ga «Bor wa l̈i pja. Pja woydër ara. Tja wopjl̈ú bop tjok» l̈e.
Jesús tjl̈ĩna Ärë, l̇l̇ëbo owa shäryë wl̈o l̈ara
E irgo ga Jesús söra Sbö Sëyarë jek öötong shäng kjok dogro no l̇l̇ëmshko,

äya kjl̈oshko so tjeng ara l̈ishko, ga beno shäng eshko dbargwo sak pkëng (40). Eshko ga tjl̈ĩna Ärë ara, l̇l̇ëbo owa shäryë wl̈o l̈ara. Ga Sbö parkagaga kjok dogo so shrono tjeng ba tjok kjl̈öbö ba kjimtë.
Jesús ba pak soyono
Juan bängzaraba shäng no shdũzl̈ong uyo roshko irgo ga Jesús jek öötong shäng Galilea kjokyo. Eshko ga Sbö tjl̈õkwo roy pjl̈ú l̈e shäng oba kong,

tjl̈ẽ ga «Dbar iara Sbörë l̈i öötonge. Sbö ber no pjl̈uyo wl̈o l̈i, e dbaryo döröe. E kjĩshko ga l̇l̇ëbo owa shäryëmi l̈öng l̈i, e owa jl̈õe l̈ozĩ, ga rayozĩa. Sbö tjl̈õkwo roy pjl̈ú l̈ër shäng bomi kong l̈i, e kjrozĩa» l̈e.
Jesús, domerga mã shaga kjrara dogl̈o pkëng (4)

Domer shäng kjl̈ara ko Simón. Kjl̈ara obi ko Andrés, e Simón l̈ëng. Epga mã shaga. Pjl̈ara ga l̈öng ba kjl̈a mã shakkl̈o dbuk Galilea di bäng buk kësbang, shkung, so dl̈ung kjoyo l̈i roshko. Eshko ga Jesús jek jëk shäng diksor go, ga ĩya ga domerga l̈i bë l̈önge.
Eshko ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «Pjãy tek bor tjok, pjãy pin wl̈o. Pjãy to l̈öng mã shak ame. Pjãy iër to ber l̈öng no töng bor kong shara» l̈e.
Kuya l̈ok ga ba kjl̈a rayara jekdo, ga to jek ba tjok.
Jek këgo sit ga domerga l̈öng do pjök ko Santiago, Juan. E data Zebedeo. Epga l̈öng ba kjl̈a mã shakkl̈o bängyë kjyong roshko ba data tjok. Ga Jesús jek shäng eshko ga domerga do pjök l̈i ĩna,
ga rokara jek ba tjok, opping ba tjok wl̈o. Kuya l̈ok ga ba data rayara jekdo, beno sök ba kjyong roshko ba parkagaga tjok, ga to jek l̈ok Jesús tjok.
Ä sëya pjang domer goshko ichara Jesúsdë kjl̈ara toe
E irgo ga to l̈ok öötong l̈öng Capernaúm kjokyo. Öötong woshtozl̈ong dbaryoshko ga Jesús opzrëno jek judíoga syõ uyo jong eshko l̈i roshko, ga nopga pina.
Tjl̈õkwo l̈ara jl̈õkoyo, dbo ara go, l̈e no pinggaga kjok l̇l̇gwekkl̈o tara Moisésdë go l̈irë dik l̇l̇ëme. E kjĩshko ga nopga l̈öng ba kuga l̈i beno l̈öng yëy l̈e erä.
Eshko ga domer shäng kjl̈ara, goshko Ä sëya kjl̈ara. Ga Jesús ĩya sëya l̈irë ga öö l̈e ba kong dbo goshko, tjl̈ẽ ga
«Jesús, Nazaret so, ¿pja tek shäng borwa barwë ega? ¿Pja tek shäng borwa pjigare? Pja ë miydër pjl̈úe. Pja iak beno shäng dboy Sbö kong» l̈e.
Kuya ga sëya l̈i wl̈ona, tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «Pja kjinkozong. Pja opkjos domer kjwe go dwayo» l̈e.
Kuya ga domer l̈i iara jek kl̈an kjl̈ul̈u erä. Eshko ga öö l̈e sëya l̈irë dbo goshko, ga opkjono to domer l̈i go dwayo.
Ĩya nopga tjeng eshko l̈irë ga beno l̈öng yëy l̈e erä, ga tjl̈ẽ ëng kong ga «¿Kjwe l̇l̇ëro? ¿Tjl̈õkwo tjagl̈ën wl̈eniyo bi kongdo l̇l̇ëm? Tjl̈õkwo kjwe dbo ara. Ä sëyaga iche ga kol̈e bakoe» l̈e.
Eshko jek l̈ëkong ga Jesús roy shdöktong jekdo Galilea kjokyo kjok kjwang jĩkong.
Simón ëm poptara Jesúsdë
E irgo ga Jesús opshino judíoga syõ uyo l̈i roshko dwayo Santiago, Juan tjok, ga jek öötong l̈öng Simón, Andrés ushko.
Eshko ga Simón ëm buk ba bukkl̈o kjing go, kjl̈irkono buk träk l̇l̇ëme. Roy l̈ara Jesús kongshko ga
jek öötong shäng swl̈o buk l̈ishko. Eshko ga orkwo shara, kojona, ga kjl̈ik l̈i zenoe. Eni ga wal̈ë l̈i dl̈i shäryono ba kong.
Swl̈opga poptara Jesúsdë ara
Jek kjok ro zar ga swl̈opga, nopga goshko Ä sëyaga, e söraba ara Jesús kong.
Kjok eshko sopga uunkong töno shrono l̈ok u bäng l̈i bokshto.
Nopga swl̈o l̇l̇ë ara poptara Jesúsdë, Ä sëyaga tjeng oba goshko l̈i ichara to bakoe. Jesús, e ë miyde Ä sëyaga tjeng oba goshko l̈irë owa l̇l̇ëme. E kjĩshko ga ichara Jesúsdë tjl̈ẽ l̇l̇ëme.
Jesús, Sbö tjl̈õkwo roy pjl̈ú l̈e judíoga syõ uyo obl̈ë obl̈ë roshko
Wẽshko kjok shröngto ga Jesús kojono, opshino jek kjok eshko dwayo, to jongya ëye l̇l̇ëmshko, syõshtë Sbö kong wl̈o.
E irgo ga Simón to shäng ba pjeyoga oppingga tjok ba wl̈ẽk.
Wl̈ẽnashko ga tjl̈ẽ l̈ok ba kong ga «Oba uunkong to l̈öng bop wl̈ẽk» l̈e.
Kuya ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «Shji to jongya kjok shto obl̈ë obl̈ë, Sbö tjl̈õkwo roy l̈ër eshko wl̈o, miydëba wl̈o. Tja shrono shäng e kong wl̈o» l̈e.
Eni ga to shäng Sbö tjl̈õkwo roy pjl̈ú l̈ë Galilea kjokyo kjrina kjrinashko, judíoga syõ uyo l̈ok kjwobi l̈i roshko. Ga Ä sëyaga tjeng oba goshko l̈i iche to bakoe.
Domer pogl̈o go swl̈o ara, sho an do jĩkong wl̈eniyo poptara Jesúsdë kjl̈ara

Pjl̈ara ga domer shrono shäng kjl̈ara Jesús shwoy. Domer l̈i pogl̈o go swl̈o ara, sho an do jĩkong. Öötong shäng Jesús zl̈ong bäng ga kjök tono ba bokshto, tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «Tja poptëp woydë ga tja poptëp ga pjl̈úe» l̈e.
Ĩya ga songe l̈e, ga porwara ba orkwo go, ga tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «Pja poptër woydë. Pja ber pjl̈ú shara» l̈e.
Jekdo eshko ga domer l̈i poptonoe.

Eshko ga Jesús tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «Tja kuzong. Pja poptoror l̈ëp ë kong l̇l̇ëme. Pja nom opping syõshtaga Sbö kong nopga kjĩshko l̈i kong, pja ĩya wl̈o eröe. Sbö sënggl̈o l̈ara Moisésdë, pja äär Sbö poshrëk ba ushko ga pjl̈ú wl̈o l̈i söp, twëp ba kong, pja poptono miydëba wl̈o» l̈e, ga ichara toe.

Gueniyo ga domer poptono l̈i to shäng kjone pogoshko ga tjl̈ẽ ga «Tja poptara Jesúsdë» l̈e ë kong pogo. E kjĩshko ga Jesús jek opzrëk u ara tjeng l̈ishko ga äe. To jek wl̈eni ga oba tön ba shwoy ara anmoyõ kjĩshko. Eni ga beno shäng no l̇l̇ëmshko. Eni ëmdë ga ĩkoba äär träk l̇l̇ëme.

footnotes.text: Drepkwota döga l̈anyo, e tak pjang Mateo 3.11 go.
Eshko ga e woshtozl̈ong dbaryo. Ga e dbaryo ga epga jëk pjola l̇l̇ëm kjĩshko ga swl̈opga söraba Jesús shwoy kjok ro zar kjwl̈ëshko.
